crossRefs.note: “For the children of Judah have done that which is evil in my sight,” says Yahweh. “They have set their abominations in…
for both prophet and priest are profane. Yes, in my house I have found their wickedness,” says Yahweh.
He built altars in Yahweh’s house, of which Yahweh said, “I will put my name in Jerusalem.”
He brought out the Asherah from Yahweh’s house, outside of Jerusalem, to the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook…
He built altars in Yahweh’s house, of which Yahweh said, “My name shall be in Jerusalem forever.”
He took away the foreign gods, and the idol out of Yahweh’s house, and all the altars that he had built in the mountain…
Then he said to me, “Son of man, lift up your eyes now the way toward the north.” So I lifted up my eyes the way toward…

translations.web: But they set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.
translations.bsb: They have placed their abominations in the house that bears My Name, and so have defiled it.
